content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-120. - Extended care leave.
content.summary:
The city may grant extended care leave to employees in accordance with applicable
               federal and state laws and a policy established by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
